violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Sand Play (26 TAC §744.2517(5))
violation_type.typical_finding: Children were observed not washing hands after coming inside from playing outdoors in the gravel. This was corrected during the inspection, when the caregivers took the children to the bathroom to wash hands.
